description: The pie chart is divided into two main categories: Virtual Characters and Real Characters, with a further subdivision of Real Characters into Custom Characters and Influencers. Virtual Characters are represented by a large blue segment, while Real Characters are shown in a smaller green segment. Custom Characters are a subset of Real Characters, depicted in a pink segment, and Influencers are another subset, shown in a light green segment. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific slices. The segments are ordered by size, with Virtual Characters being the largest and Influencers being the smallest.
